initial_application: The applied source change was HL7/fhir-extensions commit 000def6ad5860adc8396ae3fe72de66034186c29, which added ServiceRequest to input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-workflow-researchStudy.xml. The current core checkout no longer contains an active workflow-researchStudy StructureDefinition or SearchParameter source file.

Current Extension Pack source includes ServiceRequest in both StructureDefinition-workflow-researchStudy.xml and SearchParameter-workflow-researchStudy.xml. Related same-extension audits for FHIR-39656, FHIR-41308, and FHIR-43174 are already on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. A duplicate core extension definition or search parameter would be outside current core build scope.
